title: UFOs appear at the time of the Manhattan Project

tellings.quote: you have to wonder at that time because that's when all the UFOs pop up.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, points out that in the 1940s, while physicists such as Robert Oppenheimer and Edward Teller were building the first atomic bomb in the Manhattan Project, the secret US wartime effort to make it, UFO sightings started to show up. Talking about the film Oppenheimer, he says "you have to wonder at that time because that's when all the UFOs pop up." If the timing means something, it would suggest the sightings are tied to humans getting the bomb.
